provenance.method: exact: the state is not a stabilizer state (two distinct amplitude moduli)

notes: Settles chi(H^2) = 2 with the Lean upper bound qubit_h_m2_stabRankP_le_two. A stabilizer state has one modulus on its support; |H>^2 has moduli cos^2(pi/8) and cos(pi/8) sin(pi/8), which differ.
